name: Kronos
description: Kronos: A Foundation Model for the Language of Financial Markets
one_liner: A pre-trained AI model built specifically to understand and forecast patterns in financial market data, free to download and use as a starting point.
buyer: An aspiring fintech founder or quant hobbyist who wants to build a trading-signal or market-analysis product without training a model from scratch.
business_use_cases: A retail-trading tool builder fine-tunes it into a paid signal/alert service for a specific market niche (e.g. small-cap momentum).
A prop trading shop uses it as a baseline anomaly-detection layer to flag unusual price action for human review.
A fintech content creator builds a 'what the model sees' newsletter or dashboard product around its forecasts.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a subscription trading-signal or market-anomaly alert service built on top of it.
Offer a one-off custom fine-tuning service for firms wanting it adapted to their specific instrument set.

steal_this: Fine-tune it on one narrow, boring market (a single commodity or small-cap sector) this weekend and ship a daily email digest of its signal — narrow and boring beats 'general market predictor' for a first paying niche. Note: any trading-signal product has real regulatory and liability considerations — get advice before taking money for it.
